Indicators in the order x1, x2, x3, y1, ..., y8.  // Free loadings: row and column of Lambda, and the element of theta const int lambda_row[8] = {1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10}; const int lambda_col[8] = {0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2}; const int lambda_par[8] = {11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 13, 14, 15}; // Regressions: dem60 ~ ind60, dem65 ~ ind60, dem65 ~ dem60 const int beta_row[3] = {1, 2, 2}; const int beta_col[3] = {0, 0, 1}; // Residual covariances: y1-y5, y2-y4, y2-y6, y3-y7, y4-y8, y6-y8 const int cov_i[6] = {3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 8}; const int cov_j[6] = {7, 6, 8, 9, 10, 10};  struct Sem {   VectorXd nu, psi, v, rho;   MatrixXd Lambda, A, M, Theta, Sigma;  // A = (I - B)^-1, M = A Psi A' };  Sem sem_matrices(const VectorXd& theta) {   Sem s;   s.nu = theta.head(11);   s.Lambda = MatrixXd::Zero(11, 3);   s.Lambda(0, 0) = s.Lambda(3, 1) = s.Lambda(7, 2) = 1;   for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {     s.Lambda(lambda_row[k], lambda_col[k]) = theta[lambda_par[k]];   }   MatrixXd B = MatrixXd::Zero(3, 3);   for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) B(beta_row[k], beta_col[k]) = theta[16 + k];   s.A = (MatrixXd::Identity(3, 3) - B).inverse();   s.psi = theta.segment(19, 3).array().exp();   s.v = theta.segment(22, 11).array().exp();   s.rho = theta.segment(33, 6).array().tanh();   s.Theta = s.v.asDiagonal();   for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {     int i = cov_i[k], j = cov_j[k];     s.Theta(i, j) = s.Theta(j, i) = s.rho[k] * std::sqrt(s.v[i] * s.v[j]);   }   s.M = s.A * s.psi.asDiagonal() * s.A.transpose();   s.Sigma = s.Lambda * s.M * s.Lambda.transpose() + s.Theta;   return s; }  // [[Rcpp::export]] VectorXd loglik_cpp(const Map<VectorXd> theta, const Map<MatrixXd> Y) {   Sem s = sem_matrices(theta);   Eigen::LLT<MatrixXd> llt(s.Sigma);   if (llt.info() != Eigen::Success) {  // Sigma is not positive definite     return VectorXd::Constant(Y.rows(), R_NegInf);   }   MatrixXd D = Y.rowwise() - s.nu.transpose();   MatrixXd Z = llt.matrixL().solve(D.transpose());   // matrixLLT() holds L, whose diagonal gives half the log-determinant   double half_logdet = llt.matrixLLT().diagonal().array().log().sum();   double c = -0.5 * Y.cols() * std::log(2 * M_PI) - half_logdet;   return (c - 0.5 * Z.colwise().squaredNorm().array()).matrix().transpose(); }  // [[Rcpp::export]] double logprior_cpp(const Map<VectorXd> theta) {   double lp = 0;   for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) lp += R::dnorm(theta[i], 0, 32, true);   for (int i = 11; i < 19; i++) lp += R::dnorm(theta[i], 0, 10, true);   for (int i = 19; i < 33; i++) {     double sd = std::exp(theta[i] / 2);     // R::dgamma() takes the scale, 1 / rate     lp += R::dgamma(sd, 1, 1 / 0.5, true) + std::log(sd / 2);   }   for (int i = 33; i < 39; i++) {     double rho = std::tanh(theta[i]);     lp += R::dbeta((rho + 1) / 2, 1, 1, true) - std::log(2.0) +       std::log1p(-rho * rho);   }   return lp; }  // [[Rcpp::export]] double logpost_cpp(const Map<VectorXd> theta, const Map<MatrixXd> Y) {   return loglik_cpp(theta, Y).sum() + logprior_cpp(theta); } // Gradient of logpost_cpp() with respect to theta // [[Rcpp::export]] VectorXd grad_cpp(const Map<VectorXd> theta, const Map<MatrixXd> Y) {   Sem s = sem_matrices(theta);   Eigen::LLT<MatrixXd> llt(s.Sigma);   if (llt.info() != Eigen::Success) return VectorXd::Constant(39, NA_REAL);   VectorXd g = VectorXd::Zero(39);    // Log-likelihood, through G = d loglik / d Sigma   int n = Y.rows();   MatrixXd Omega = llt.solve(MatrixXd::Identity(11, 11));   MatrixXd OD = Omega * (Y.rowwise() - s.nu.transpose()).transpose();   MatrixXd G = 0.5 * (OD * OD.transpose() - n * Omega);    g.head(11) = OD.rowwise().sum();   MatrixXd dLambda = 2 * G * s.Lambda * s.M;   for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {     g[lambda_par[k]] += dLambda(lambda_row[k], lambda_col[k]);   }   MatrixXd LGL = s.Lambda.transpose() * G * s.Lambda;   MatrixXd dB = 2 * s.A.transpose() * LGL * s.M;   for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) g[16 + k] = dB(beta_row[k], beta_col[k]);   MatrixXd dPsi = s.A.transpose() * LGL * s.A;   for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) g[19 + k] = dPsi(k, k) * s.psi[k];   for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) g[22 + i] = G(i, i) * s.v[i];   for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {     int i = cov_i[k], j = cov_j[k];     g[22 + i] += G(i, j) * s.Theta(i, j);     g[22 + j] += G(i, j) * s.Theta(i, j);     g[33 + k] = 2 * G(i, j) * (1 - s.rho[k] * s.rho[k]) *       std::sqrt(s.v[i] * s.v[j]);   }    // Log-prior, with the Jacobians   for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++) g[i] -= theta[i] / (32.0 * 32.0);   for (int i = 11; i < 19; i++) g[i] -= theta[i] / (10.0 * 10.0);   for (int i = 19; i < 33; i++) g[i] += 0.5 - std::exp(theta[i] / 2) / 4;   for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) g[33 + k] -= 2 * s.rho[k];   return g; } Rcpp::sourceCpp(cpp_file) set.seed(1) points <- c(   list(init, theta_inlavaan),   replicate(4, init + rnorm(39, sd = 0.3), simplify = FALSE) ) vapply(points, function(th) logpost_cpp(th, Y) - logpost_r(th, Y), 0) #> [1] -4.547474e-13  0.000000e+00  0.000000e+00 -2.273737e-13  0.000000e+00 #> [6] -4.547474e-13 max(abs(loglik_cpp(theta_inlavaan, Y) - loglik_r(theta_inlavaan, Y))) #> [1] 3.552714e-15 fd_grad <- function(f, x, h = 1e-5) {   vapply(     seq_along(x),     function(j) {       e <- replace(numeric(length(x)), j, h)       (f(x + e) - f(x - e)) / (2 * h)     },     0   ) } vapply(   points,   function(th) {     g_fd <- fd_grad(function(x) logpost_r(x, Y), th)     max(abs(grad_cpp(th, Y) - g_fd) / (1 + abs(g_fd)))   },   0 ) #> [1] 1.461419e-08 1.625418e-08 9.214642e-09 7.379461e-09 3.295428e-09 #> [6] 6.734287e-09

Write \(D\) \(n \times 11\) matrix data minus \(\nu\) \(\Omega = \Sigma^{-1}\). derivative log-likelihood \(\Omega D^\top \mathbf{1}\) respect \(\nu\), \[ G = \tfrac{1}{2} \left( \Omega D^\top D \, \Omega - n \Omega \right) \] respect \(\Sigma\). \(\Sigma = \Lambda M \Lambda^\top + \Theta\), \(= (- B)^{-1}\) \(M = \Psi ^\top\), derivatives respect model matrices \[ \frac{\partial \ell}{\partial \Lambda} = 2 G \Lambda M, \qquad \frac{\partial \ell}{\partial B} = 2 ^\top \Lambda^\top G \Lambda M, \qquad \frac{\partial \ell}{\partial \Psi} = ^\top \Lambda^\top G \Lambda , \] \(G_{ii}\) residual variance \(\theta_{ii}\) \(2 G_{ij}\) residual covariance. loading held equal across years sums two entries. unconstrained scale, log variance multiplies derivative variance. residual covariance \(\theta_{ij} = \rho \sqrt{\theta_{ii} \theta_{jj}}\) moves \(z\), \(d\theta_{ij} / dz = (1 - \rho^2) \sqrt{\theta_{ii} \theta_{jj}}\), log variances, \(d\theta_{ij} / d\ell_i = \theta_{ij} / 2\). log-prior adds \(-\vartheta / s^2\) normal prior, \(1/2 - \sigma / 4\) log variance \(-2\rho\) correlation. append gradient file:

title: Using TMB
text: TMB template declares data parameters, returns value minimise, negative log-posterior. density::MVNORM_t TMB’s multivariate normal; returns negative log-density, normalising constant included. 75 pointwise log-likelihoods kept vector, REPORT() makes available R. log-prior adds log-Jacobians standard deviations correlations, Rcpp article.
code: tmb_file <- file.path(tempdir(), "sem_tmb.cpp") #include <TMB.hpp>  template <class Type> Type objective_function<Type>::operator()() {   DATA_MATRIX(Y);            // 75 x 11: x1, x2, x3, y1, ..., y8    PARAMETER_VECTOR(nu);      // 11 intercepts   PARAMETER_VECTOR(lam);     // loadings: x2, x3, then a, b, c   PARAMETER_VECTOR(beta);    // dem60 ~ ind60, dem65 ~ ind60, dem65 ~ dem60   PARAMETER_VECTOR(logv_lv); // log variances of ind60, dem60, dem65   PARAMETER_VECTOR(logv_ov); // log residual variances, x1 to y8   PARAMETER_VECTOR(z);       // residual correlations, atanh scale    int n = Y.rows(), p = Y.cols();    // Loadings, with the first of each latent variable fixed at 1, and a, b, c   // shared between 1960 and 1965   matrix<Type> Lambda(p, 3);   Lambda.setZero();   Lambda(0, 0) = 1;   Lambda(1, 0) = lam(0);   Lambda(2, 0) = lam(1);   Lambda(3, 1) = 1;   Lambda(4, 1) = lam(2);   Lambda(5, 1) = lam(3);   Lambda(6, 1) = lam(4);   Lambda(7, 2) = 1;   Lambda(8, 2) = lam(2);   Lambda(9, 2) = lam(3);   Lambda(10, 2) = lam(4);    matrix<Type> B(3, 3);   B.setZero();   B(1, 0) = beta(0);   B(2, 0) = beta(1);   B(2, 1) = beta(2);   matrix<Type> I(3, 3);   I.setIdentity();   matrix<Type> A = atomic::matinv(matrix<Type>(I - B));    vector<Type> psi = exp(logv_lv);   vector<Type> v = exp(logv_ov);   vector<Type> rho = tanh(z);   matrix<Type> Psi = psi.matrix().asDiagonal();   matrix<Type> Theta = v.matrix().asDiagonal();   // Residual covariances: y1-y5, y2-y4, y2-y6, y3-y7, y4-y8, y6-y8   int ci[6] = {3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 8};   int cj[6] = {7, 6, 8, 9, 10, 10};   for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {     Theta(ci[k], cj[k]) = rho(k) * sqrt(v(ci[k]) * v(cj[k]));     Theta(cj[k], ci[k]) = Theta(ci[k], cj[k]);   }    matrix<Type> LA = Lambda * A;   matrix<Type> Sigma = LA * Psi * LA.transpose() + Theta;    // Pointwise log-likelihood   density::MVNORM_t<Type> mvn(Sigma);   vector<Type> loglik(n);   for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {     vector<Type> r = vector<Type>(Y.row(i)) - nu;     loglik(i) = -mvn(r);   }   REPORT(loglik);    // Log-prior on the unconstrained scale, with the Jacobians   Type logprior = sum(dnorm(nu, Type(0), Type(32), true)) +     sum(dnorm(lam, Type(0), Type(10), true)) +     sum(dnorm(beta, Type(0), Type(10), true));   vector<Type> logv(14);   logv << logv_lv, logv_ov;   for (int k = 0; k < 14; k++) {     // Gamma(1, rate 0.5) on the SD (TMB's dgamma() takes the scale), and     // d SD / d logv = SD / 2     Type sd = exp(logv(k) / Type(2));     logprior += dgamma(sd, Type(1), Type(1 / 0.5), true) + log(sd / Type(2));   }   for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {     // Beta(1, 1) on (rho + 1) / 2, and d rho / d z = 1 - rho^2     Type u = (rho(k) + Type(1)) / Type(2);     logprior += dbeta(u, Type(1), Type(1), true) - log(Type(2)) +       log(Type(1) - rho(k) * rho(k));   }    return -(sum(loglik) + logprior); }
